concepts.title: Integers: A Quick Recap
concepts.definition: Integers fill the whole number line: positive numbers, zero and negative numbers together, so that temperatures below zero, steps to the left and amounts owed all have a number of their own.
concepts.key_idea: Integers complete the number line: every step left of zero now has a name and an order.

concepts.title: Adding and Subtracting Integers
concepts.definition: On the number line, adding a positive integer moves right and adding a negative moves left; subtraction works as the reverse move, so every sum and difference is a journey with a landing point.
concepts.key_idea: Sign decides direction, size decides distance: the journey metaphor answers every addition and subtraction.

write a token game story for -4 + 9

solution_steps.explain: Place the first number on the number line.
Add the second integer with its sign; the landing point is the result.

concepts.title: Multiplying Integers: Sign Rules
concepts.definition: Multiplying integers follows the sign law: same signs give a positive product, different signs give a negative one, and the magnitudes multiply as usual, so -4 x -3 = 12 while -4 x 3 = -12.
concepts.formula: same signs positive, different signs negative
concepts.key_idea: Two negatives make a positive: flipping direction twice lands you back on the positive side.
question_patterns: evaluate -4 x -3
find the product of -6 and 5

evaluate 7 x -2 x -1
why does a negative times a negative give a positive

solution_steps.explain: Say the rule in your own words.
Work it out on one small example from the chapter.
Verify by reversing or re-checking, then conclude.

concepts.title: Division of Integers and Its Sign Law
concepts.definition: Division of integers repeats the sign law of multiplication: same signs divide to a positive quotient, different signs to a negative one, and checking by multiplying back confirms every answer.
concepts.key_idea: Division undoes multiplication: the sign law must agree in both directions, which is why it stays the same.

solution_steps.explain: Check whether the two integers carry the same or different signs.
Divide the sizes and attach the sign the law gives.
